title: GPU-Accelerated VLSI Routing using Group Steiner Trees
gpu_scope: CUDA-aware MPI approximate Group Steiner Tree computation specialized to grid-structured VLSI routing graphs.
notes: Grid/VLSI-specific graph structure rather than general sparse graphs; validate against general-graph fixtures before treating as a direct match.
collection_variant_note: VLSI routing constraints restrict the problem domain; unrestricted group-Steiner semantics have not been established.
